newsitem.title: USA: Soros not planning Zitel stake - source.
newsitem.headline: Soros not planning Zitel stake - source.

text.p: Soros Fund Management does not currently own an interest in Zitel Corp, or is it planning to purchase a stake in the company, a source close to Soros said.
Shares in Zitel, which have surged lately partially because of a rumored investment by Soros, tumbled 16-1/2 to 44-3/4 in late afternoon activity.
Soros spokesman Shawn Pattison declined comment on Zitel, saying, "It is the policy of Soros Fund Management not to comment on market rumors."
However, a source close to Soros Fund Management said the firm had no position in Zitel, nor did it plan one.
